ivy: FYI ran the node + go examples in CI and hit a weird combination: retries reuse request_id and a base64-encoded header leaked because our redactor missed it. OTEL_LOG_INJECTION=true uncovered it.

noah: raw log?

ivy: snippet: `2026-12-08T09:12:01Z INFO http.req path=/chat request_id=op-9a7c attempt=1 auth_hdr=Bearer c2tfbGl2ZV9TS0VSMjM=` then on retry `2026-12-08T09:12:02Z WARN http.req path=/chat request_id=op-9a7c attempt=2 auth_hdr=Bearer [REDACTED]` so the token was visible on attempt=1, redacted on attempt=2.

priya: that's alarming. base64 in headers won't match our simple regex for sk_live_. We assume plaintext tokens. Also retry middleware copies ctx and preserves reqid causing same op id across attempts.

noah: parity note: Go SDK used to set operation_id + attempt field, Node kept single reqid and mutated it. We should standardize to operation_id (stable) + attempt_id (unique) across SDKs.

ivy: agreed. fix plan: (1) preserve stable operation_id on the outer request and add attempt_id for each network attempt; (2) make redactor detect base64 payloads and decode-try-redact then re-encode (best-effort), and (3) make redaction idempotent so multiple passes don't mangle placeholders.

omar: decoding headers is risky but ok as opt-in behind config REDWOOD_REDACT_DECODE_BASE64=true. Also ensure we don't throw on invalid base64. For idempotency: skip values already equal to "[REDACTED]" and avoid regex that matches brace-wrapped placeholders.

priya: CI addition: examples/ci script that starts example with OTEL_LOG_INJECTION=true and REDWOOD_REDACT_DECODE_BASE64=true, triggers auth retry, then greps for bare token patterns (sk_live_ or base64-looking strings) and fails if any remain. Also assert logs include operation_id and attempt_id.

noah: small implementation note: in log formatter cast guard: `rid, _ := ctx.Value(reqIDKey).(string); if rid=="" { rid="op-init" }` so we never stringify nil as `undefined`. And ensure OTEL injection merges fields instead of overwriting.

ivy: i'll open PR with the node changes + CI script. priya can you take base64 redactor in go? mar can do python parity?

telemetry-bot: NOTE: created issue #5120 (devex) "examples: retry reuses request_id + base64 header missed by redactor; OTEL exposes init race" by ivy

priya: will do. adding a unit test for two-pass redaction and a smoke test for op/attempt fields.
